conventions.events: onClick / onChange on widgets; prefer self-describing handlers
conventions.layout: Yoga flex props (flexDirection, justifyContent, alignItems, gap, padding)
conventions.root: always UI.SetRoot after building the tree
conventions.safe_area: interactive content in UI.SafeAreaView; full-bleed art outside
conventions.two_states: clickable controls must look different when pressed: theme.lua provides primaryPressed + pressedBorderWidth/pressedPadding; atlas skins bind state_sprites.pressed from component-map.json
